feeds.title: The Australian Farmer
feeds.description: The editorial purpose of The Australian Farmer is to fill in the blanks - not just with the latest news and trends of importance to farmers, but also with product reviews and farmer contributions. The aim is to provide some assistance and help Australia's farmers to stay ahead of the game.

feeds.title: The Unbreakable Farmer Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Unbreakable Farmer's blog. Here, Warren writes articles that offer insights into various mental health challenges, coping strategies, and personal narratives that remind us we are never alone in our struggles.

feeds.title: National Centre For Farmer Health Blog
feeds.description: Focusing on prevention and early identification of risk factors associated with farming populations, the National Centre for Farmer Health (NCFH) develops timely, appropriate, effective and popular interventions. Often working in partnership with industry rural organisations and academia. The NCFH team includes professionals from the health, agricultural, social sciences and information technology disciplines who have a proven capacity to deliver in the areas of education training, applied research and community engagement.

feeds.title: Dirty Clean Food Blog
feeds.description: Dirty Clean Food is an Australian grocery delivery company that specializes in regenerative agriculture products. This means that they source their food from farms that use sustainable practices to improve the health of the soil and environment. Dirty Clean Food offers a wide range of products, including fresh fruit and vegetables, meat, seafood, dairy, and pantry items. They also offer a variety of prepared meals and snacks.

feeds.title: Farming Together Blog
feeds.description: Farming Together was born through the Farm Co-operatives and Collaboration Pilot Program, a $15 million program funded by the Australian Commonwealth Government. The Program fostered innovative, collaborative models such as co-operatives to help farmers, fishing, and forestry groups tackle supply chain issues, drought, and climate change, and deliver triple bottom line benefits including improved farm gate returns.

feeds.title: Brookfarm Blog
feeds.description: Brookfarm is an Australian company that produces premium macadamia products, including muesli, granola, porridge, muesli bars, nut mixes, and macadamia oils. They are also regenerative macadamia farmers, meaning that they use sustainable practices to care for their land and the environment. Brookfarm's products are all-natural, preservative-free, and non-GMO.

feeds.title: SA Farmer
feeds.description: SA Farmer keeps you up to date with the latest stories on primary producers, small businesses, and independent farmers, plus the latest agricultural news, developments, and challenges.

feeds.title: Australasian Farmers' & Dealers' Journal
feeds.description: Australasian Farmers' & Dealers' Journal (AFDJ) has been published since 1984 and is recognized as the main industry news source for contacting farm machinery and equipment distributors, and farm supply stores. It covers news, information, and products from manufacturers, importers, suppliers and dealers, large-scale farm producers, and contractors.

feeds.title: Small Farms Magazine
feeds.description: Small Farms is a magazine and website that provides information and resources to small-scale farmers. The website includes articles on a variety of topics, including farming, animals, plants, technology, DIY, books, and current events.

feeds.title: Grass Roots Magazine
feeds.description: Grass Roots is Australia's go-to magazine for those who wish to live a more productive and fulfilling life. Articles in the magazine are written by diverse authors who offer a wealth of experience that can be relied upon. Day to day experts share achievable projects to increase self-reliance, save you money and improve your lifestyle.

feeds.title: LIC Australia
feeds.description: Livestock Improvement Corporation Ltd (LIC) is a New Zealand farmer-owned cooperative that provides a range of solutions to improve the productivity and prosperity of farmers. LIC Australia is a wholly owned subsidiary of LIC. Since the 1970 LIC has been delivering the very best of LIC's leading-edge dairy cattle genetics and solutions to farmers all over Australia whether they are in Tasmania or Gippsland, and by doing so, helping Australian farmers become more prosperous and productive towards a more secure future.

feeds.title: Australian Farm Institute
feeds.description: An independent institute leading farm policy discussions for Australian agriculture. The Australian Farm Institute has been established to conduct research into public policy issues impacting the Australian farm sector and to promote policy solutions that maximize the economic and social wellbeing of farmers. To do this, the Institute conducts research projects on specific farm policy issues, promoting the outcomes of this research to policy-makers.

feeds.title: Cattle Australia
feeds.description: Representing the interests of all Australian cattle producers, Cattle Australia is the national peak body for the grass-fed cattle industry, providing a visible, unified, and influential voice for producers. It will provide clear leadership and direction by developing and driving contemporary policy, guiding research, development, and adoption (RD&A) and marketing investment for the sector, and advocating on all matters important to the Australian cattle industry.

feeds.title: Gippsland Farmer
feeds.description: The Gippsland Farmer is a monthly agricultural newspaper reporting on rural news. For more than 40 years Gippsland Farmer has reported on a range of issues and industries including dairy, beef, vegetables, sheep, goats, poultry, organic farming, and viticulture.

feeds.title: Beef Central
feeds.description: Beef Central is regularly updated with content written specifically for the Australian beef industry, including local, national, and international industry news, market and price trends sections dedicated to the production, processing, lot feeding, live export, and international beef trade.

feeds.title: Urban Green Farms Blog
feeds.description: Urban Green Farms is Australia's premium ambient indoor and outdoor garden provider. The range of exclusive products extends well beyond traditional gardening methods. The specialized and dedicated team of experts in Hydroponics, Aquaponics, and Permaculture have united to create a food revolution far beyond its years. Urban Green Farms Blog features posts on topics such as product reviews, growing hacks, gardening tips, Tips To Accelerate Germination Naturally, and many more interesting subjects.

feeds.title: The Yallamundi Farm Blog
feeds.description: Yallamundi Farm is a family-owned farm in Australia that produces pasture-raised and organic eggs. The farm is committed to sustainable and ethical farming practices, and its eggs are carbon-neutral. Discover the latest insights and stories from Yallamundi Farm on the blog. Explore sustainable farming practices, get up close and personal with hens, and share in the special events and celebrations that mark the calendar.

feeds.title: Jonai Farms & Meatsmiths Blog
feeds.description: Jonai Farms & Meatsmiths is a resilient, diverse family farm in Eganstown, Victoria, Australia, that focuses on living a life in common with nature and managing animals for optimum soil health. The farm is passionate about agroecology, which is a holistic approach to farming that emphasizes ecological principles and social justice.

feeds.title: Farm Owners Academy Blog
feeds.description: Farm Owners Academy is the leading provider of business coaching and education for farming families in Australia, and is dedicated to helping you achieve more profit, more control, and more freedom in your farm business, now and into the future. It exists to help farmers like you. Academy coaches farm owners who are committed to running a Platinum-level business; It will lead you towards higher profitability and lower working hours; and help you create your very own 'Freedom Farm'.

feeds.title: George The Farmer Blog
feeds.description: George the Farmer is an Australian children's book and educational resource brand that teaches kids about agriculture and where their food and fiber come from. The George the Farmer team is passionate about educating and inspiring the next generation about agriculture. They believe that knowledge is power and that by teaching kids about where their food comes from, they can help them make informed choices about their food and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Australian Farmers Blog
feeds.description: Australian Farmers was initiated in 2016 by the National Farmers' Federation. The intention of this site is to share a farmer's perspective on industry news and issues that are relevant from paddock to plate. Think of it as a window into the industry, where readers can find agricultural information with farmers and the broader community.

feeds.title: Farmdeck Blog
feeds.description: Farmdeck is an Australian agriculture IoT company that provides a private network and application for farmers to monitor and manage their farms. Farmdeck's sensors and network connectivity allow farmers to collect data on a variety of factors, such as animal health, asset status, chemical usage, electric fence voltage, energy consumption, fuel levels, and grazing patterns.

feeds.title: Farming For Abundance Blog
feeds.description: Abundance Farm is an Australian online retailer of farm produce, permaculture books, and other sustainable living products. The farm was established in 2015 with the mission to contribute to the advent of regenerative living by direct action and provision of tools and knowledge.

feeds.title: The Farmer Magazine
feeds.description: The Farmer Magazine is a grass-roots farming organization that represents farm businesses and rural communities of all shapes and sizes right across NSW. It is the voice of farmers in NSW, representing rural and regional communities and working to secure a sustainable food and fiber future.

feeds.title: The Weekly Times
feeds.description: The voice of the country since 1869, The Weekly Times is Australia's biggest, best, and most comprehensive rural news service across print and online by a country mile. The team of award-winning journalists and photographers delivers news and insightful commentary on local, state, and national events without fear or favor.

feeds.title: Soils For Life Blog
feeds.description: Soils For Life is a not-for-profit charity supporting farmers to regenerate soils and landscapes, build natural and social capital, and transform the food system for the benefit of all. Stay up to date with the latest news from agriculture, field trips, tips and advice, and more!

feeds.title: Global Farmer In Australia
feeds.description: The Global Farmer has one objective and that is to be the facilitator for a thoughtful conversation on the proposition of the need for a change throughout the structure of Australian agriculture.
